name: Ilthag's Undertower
summary: Ilthag's Undertower is a ruined tower in Upper Craglorn containing Iron Orcs. They use it as a training facility for their war beasts. Skavengers are found in numbers within.
notes: Prior to Update 12, this location was an instanced 4-player Group Delve.
To progress in the delve you must drop down a hole at the beginning but you can use a ladder to climb back.
